dataset: GramNegAccum: compound accumulation in Gram-negative bacteria (eNTRy rules)
role: external validation only; not pooled with CHAMP for training

paper.title: Predictive Compound Accumulation Rules Yield a Broad-Spectrum Antibiotic
paper.authors: Richter, M. F.; Drown, B. S.; Riley, A. P.; Garcia, A.; Shirai, T.; Svec, R. L.; Hergenrother, P. J.

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.declared_on: the Zenodo archive of tag v1.0, not on the GitHub repository (which carries no LICENSE file)

provenance.why_not_zenodo: The Zenodo archive is an 81 MB zip that is mostly porin MD figures; the data is 207 KB of CSV. Downloading the archive to confirm equivalence was blocked by Zenodo with HTTP 403 'unusual traffic from your network', a temporary IP block.
provenance.licence_chain: The Zenodo record declares CC BY 4.0 and lists https://github.com/HergenrotherLab/GramNegAccum/tree/v1.0 as a related identifier, so the archived object is that tag. The files here are from that same tag.
provenance.pending_verification: Re-download the Zenodo archive once the IP block clears and check these SHA256 values against accum/data/table<N>.csv inside it. Until then the licence chain rests on the Zenodo related-identifier link rather than on a byte-level match.

format_note: The CSVs use CR-only line endings. Convert \r to \n before parsing, or csv.DictReader fails.

files.note: The n=68 training set behind the eNTRy rules, with 304 MOE descriptors.

usable_external_set.caveat: Only 151 compounds and 15% positive, against 1132 compounds at a different balance in CHAMP. Report confidence intervals; a single number here is not meaningful.

eNTRy_rules.note: The published rules report no AUC, so running them on CHAMP under the same split produces a number that does not exist yet.

attribution_required: Richter et al. Nature 2017, DOI 10.1038/nature22308; data via Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.19798859, CC BY 4.0

evidence.why: the eNTRy rules' own compounds. External validation only, never pooled for training.
